explanation: The Grimm brothers published Children's and Household Tales in 1812. Andersen's first booklet followed in 1835, and unlike the Grimms, who collected folk tales, he invented most of his own.

claims.text: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm published the first volume of Children's and Household Tales in 1812.
Hans Christian Andersen's first booklet of fairy tales was published in Copenhagen in 1835.
The Grimms collected existing folk tales, while Andersen invented most of his tales himself.
